items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Ruby Shoes' (Ruby's show) as a band/leader that played in the same venues as Dejount, but does not state a personal connection, collaboration, or direct interaction with Ruby Shoes himself.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I'm talking about a nice hall, they can't have that. Yeah. That... ...the Dijon used to fill all the time. Uh-huh. ...and Dijon used to come in a hall hall, same way, you know. ...and... ...we had a nice hall, he was in the Marines. And... ...and... ...Loopy Shoes... ...he would then come out there, you know. Yeah.
How was... How was the Dijon's band? Was it the same... ...like... ...Ruby Shoes' band? No, no, yeah.
It's the same thing that plays that right now. Right now. Yeah.
